purpose: Teach: エンジェル/ルーマニア/ミレニアム/ギルド/ワイドショー/クリエイター/サイレント/ロフト

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、エンジェルケーキを召し上がってらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer was eating angel cake.
lines.style: Soft, wondering tone. Speaking to herself as much as to Aoi. Gentle observation, almost tender. Pace unhurried, like she's noticing something small and precious.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ルーマニアからの留学生さんだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Oh, they're an exchange student from Romania.
lines.style: Light, interested. A small discovery shared. Warm but not overstated. The natural rhythm of someone sharing something they just learned.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ミレニアム世代の文化論を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: They were talking about millennial culture — really thoughtfully too.
lines.style: Slight lift of admiration in the voice. Attentive, noticing depth in a stranger. Soft delivery, no performance, just genuine interest in what she heard.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、オンラインゲームのギルドリーダーだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Apparently they're a guild leader for an online game.
lines.style: Easy acknowledgment. A detail that adds texture. Not surprised, just intrigued. Matter-of-fact warmth, the way you note something interesting about someone you're growing fond of.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、朝のワイドショーに出演されたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: They said they appeared on a morning talk show once.
lines.style: Quiet noticing, no judgment. The tone of someone collecting small truths about a person. Relaxed pacing, like she's thinking out loud with a trusted friend.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、フリーのクリエイターとしてご活躍だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: They work as a freelance creator.
lines.style: Simple statement with underlying warmth. Recognition of someone making their own way. Steady tone, grounded, respectful of that independence.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、サイレント映画のコレクションを語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: And they have this whole collection of silent films they were telling me about.
lines.style: Slight wonder in the voice. The pleasure of discovering layers to someone. Unhurried, trailing slightly on the end like there's more to appreciate.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ロフトのある住宅にお住まいだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: They live in a place with a loft.
lines.style: Final small detail, gently satisfied. Closing observation with a tender smile underneath. Slightly softer still, like a quiet period at the end of a thought.
